questions.q:
What is the unit digit of 55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545?

55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545 का इकाई अंक क्या है?
questions.s:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

Cyclicity chart:

NumberCyclicityUnit digit values
Power 1Power 2Power 3Power 4
010
111
242486
343971
4246
515
616
747931
848426
9291

(Note: when remainder is 0, power = cyclicity)

In the given series 55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545, we can see that power of every next term is increased by 4 than power of previous number and from cyclicity table, we can see the cyclicity of numbers from 0 to 9.

Now, from cyclicity, we know unit digit of 5th power of 5 will be 5, 9th power of 6 will be 6 and so on.

Then, unit digit of 55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545 = unit digit of (5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + .. + 15)

In the above series,

First term = 5 = a

Last term = 15 = an

Common difference = d = 6 - 5 = 1

Then, an = a + (n - 1)d

15 = 5 + (n - 1) x 1

n = 11

Then, unit digit of (5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + .. + 15)

= unit digit of (n/2)(a + an)

= unit digit of (11/2)(5 + 15)

= unit digit of 110

= 0

वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या जो 208, 258 और 308 को विभाजित करने पर प्रत्येक स्थिति में शेष 8 छोड़ती है।
questions_hin.s_hi:
The required number will be HCF of (208 - 8), (258 - 8) and (308 - 8) = 200, 250 and 300

HCF of 200, 250 and 300 = 50

questions_hin.q_hi:
Three numbers are in the ratio of 2:4:5 respectively. If the LCM of these numbers is 1760, then find the HCF of the numbers.

तीन संख्याएँ क्रमशः 2:4:5 के अनुपात में हैं। यदि इन संख्याओं का LCM 1760 है, तो संख्याओं का HCF ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
LCM of the numbers = 1760

Let the three numbers be 2x, 4x, 5x.

LCM of the numbers= 20x

LCM of the numbers = 20x = 1760

x = 88

Thus, HCF of the numbers = 88

questions_hin.q_hi:

questions_hin.s_hi:
The numbers of zeros in the multiplication will be from the numbers 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 which are 5 in number. One more zero when 50 and 20 are multiplied together.

=> Total 5 + 1 = 6

questions_hin.q_hi: 6. यदि x2y= 67 तो  x-yx+y  + 1419 का मान क्या होगा ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
6.(a)  x2y= 67

दोनों पक्षों की तुलना करने पर हमें प्राप्त होता है,

x = 6 और y =72  = 3.5

अब, x-yx+y  + 1419

= 6 - 3.56+3.5 + 1419

= 2.59.5 + 1419

= 2.5×29.5×2 + 1419

= 519 + 1419 = 1919 = 1
